blocks.text: GLOBAL EVENTS— This is the most amazing and astonishing hour the earth has witnessed since the days of Christ! We are turning the corner towards heaven as worldwide events are fulfillling prophecy in every important way! — It seems that everyone including the cults and sections of the nominals are trying to be partly involved in the miracle and healing move of God! “But the real outpouring of fire is coming upon the true children of the Lord as He pours His spirit upon all flesh! But all will not receive it finally. Listen my partner, the former and latter rain and the midnight cry will soon end! According to prophecy the Lord is soon headed towards Israel to seal the 144,000. (Rev. chap. 7) and send the two witnesses. (Rev. 11:1-6) — Right now we should prepare ourself for the Translation as we are pushing towards century end! “Behold, saith the Lord of Host, I shall soon return! Be ye awake!”

IN A FUTURISTIC PERIOD— As we end this generation already events are occurring seemingly beyond science fiction! Since 1995 technology and science has advanced almost into the 4th dimension but not quite! But they are now working on antimatter working with the positive and negative. They say they can use the energy for good; but this works on the same term as the atomic, but more devastating! — Actually one scientist said it could split the earth and tear up the galaxy and cause a space wobble! Nevertheless we are going to have one anyway in our galaxy as the earth’s axis is preparing to tilt. — In 1908 they reported at that time that something came out of the heavens and exploded over the Siberian section of Russia. It leveled hundreds of miles of timber, etc. The shock wave was felt around the world. What it was, was antimatter nuclear asteroid type that exploded above ground. It was the most devastation that was ever witnessed. It remains a mystery to this day because there was no asteroid holes left, only radiation. And nothing grew in that area for many many years. And now man is dealing in the God of forces. (Dan. 11:36-40) — This reveals the anti-Christ is soon to appear! Mankind now is dealing with radio waves that they are sending through the shield (of the heavens that protects the earth from the sun) as a weapon. It’s leaving X-rays in the air also!

CONTINUING PROPHECY— Never have we seen such record breaking weather patterns! “Storms and great shakings, heat waves. Diseases and pestilences are in every nation!” — Another sign great lights has been seen over Israel as they are going through an explosive troublesome time! As I said they would go through many pitfalls before they receive a false peace covenant in this decade! “This year has been full of dramatic events just as predicted.” And concerning many of the events that we mentioned above they will also increase in intensification! (Weather, etc.)

CONTINUING— Volcanic activity is beginning to take place in different parts of the world. Scientists now claim that is associated to earthquakes and it changes the weather patterns, as we predicted long ago! — “We are living in a remarkable age of dynamic futuristic and fulfillment of events!” What scientists are studying we are going to reveal in some following Scriptures and a past note. — Hag. 2:6-7, For thus saith the Lord of hosts; Yet once, it is a little while, and I will shake the heavens and the earth, and the sea, and the dry land; And I will shake all nations, and the desire of all nations shall come: and I will fill this house with glory, saith the Lord of hosts. — This serves a double-triple prophecy! — The world will see much of it during the rest of this decade! And the rest of it as we cross the century! And by 2003 this planet will have went under a total change again! — “Behold, saith the Almighty I will flatten the mountains into dust. The hills will melt like wax, the seas will roar and overflow their bounds as the earth rocks back and forth!” — Now I do not know when all of this will take place for certain, but it’ll probably come within some of the dates on the Scripts. — “But I do know this planet is moving swiftly towards Tribulation, Armageddon and the Millennium!” — The tectonic plates are moving underneath the earth preparing for some continental upheavals!

CONTINUING PROPHECY— The ring of fire in the Pacific is acting up as great earthquakes are coming. But wait, here is some more evidential Scriptures. Isa. 24:1, Behold, the Lord maketh the earth empty, and maketh it waste, and turneth it upside down, and scattereth abroad the inhabitants thereof. — (Read vrs. 19-20) And also the

CONTINUING THE FUTURE— Note this reprint — “We are living in a most dramatic and astonishing age that could well be such a Scripture as this.” Hab. 2:2-3, “And the Lord answered me, and said, Write the vision, and make it plain upon the tables, that he may run that readeth it. For the vision is yet for an appointed time, but at the end it shall speak, and not lie: though it tarry, wait for it; because it will surely come, it will not tarry. The elect will catch the gospel vision and should run and work swiftly now in telling of salvation, deliverance and return of the Lord! (The midnight cry is here. Matt. 25:6) We can see the signs in the heavens, beneath the earth, the shaking and travailing of nations. The stirring of the kings of the east. — The sudden new burst and increase of science and technology! The extreme wickedness, immoral conditions and apostasy! — The movements of government in and electronics. The violence and actions of society and etc. — “The last generation is running out!” Jesus said, the night cometh when no man worketh! — The spiritual rain and latter times are ending soon!

SIGNS AND LIGHTS IN THE HEAVENS (Luke 21:11)— The Scripts predicted in the late 80’s and 90’s that tremendous and diverse signs would appear in the heavens! And the earth has seen some very mysterious ones! — “We are told of new comets coming! — In 1996, a brilliant comet entered into view. Some said it was the brightest in 20 years, some said in 400 years. — In 1997, they claim an incredible bright comet is coming!” — We have just had some major eclipses near the last comet; and we will have some more. “The Scripts predicted from 1997-99 will be the most awesome period up to date in this century and will spill over into the 21st century!” — Some asteroids have already crashed into buildings, into the sea and one smashed a parked car completely. Now one scientists said that they are watching some near the earth. And said that one would hit by 1999. We are going to have more than one hit before it’s all over! (Read Rev. chap. 8) — We know violence and etc. — Note: Before we end here, some good things are happening! “God’s people are being blessed as never before through the miraculous! As men sleep, He is gathering His own!” — In the next paragraph, we will tell of a marvelous incident!

ANGELIC VISITATION— This is a true story as reported over T.V. and elsewhere! It involves an accident. A man was riding a motorcycle on a rainy night through a country road. And he had a devastating accident. They called the paramedics and they tried to revive him in the rain, and all the instruments they were using quit working and he died. There was a nurse and 4 medics. All of a sudden they saw this figure coming towards them out of the woods carrying a Bible! This mysterious figure startled them, as the form bent over the body and put the Bible on the man’s heart. And one of the medics said, don’t bother whoever this is! And the angelic being laid it up and down over the heart a few times, turned and vanished in the rain towards the woods. Then they looked and to their amazement the man was recovering. All the medics including the woman nurse testified that this was truly a miracle from God! The man lived and said, he sure would like to meet whoever it was that saved his life. He was a believer! — It proved the Word (Bible) is true! — Also it says be careful for you may entertain angels unaware! “Amen, for God’s divine intervention and providence!” — A writer that has took note of many of these type incidents says, that we have guardian angels! — “And if it is not a person’s time to go then they intervene! But if it’s their time, they allow them to go on to meet God!”

COMING EVENTS— This earth should get ready! Some of the most drastic, shocking and amazing changes are going to take place within the next few years! And on the other hand, I wrote years ago that if you told people what was going to take place during the 80’s and 90’s, they would not be able to believe it until they saw it. And this is occurring. We cannot list all of the bizarre and to some, unbelievable events that are actually taking place! — But we will list some in our forthcoming scripts and literature. You don’t want to miss any of it. This is the age of realism for the elect saints, and delusion & illusion surrounding the world like a cloud. A snare shall surely come saith
